Investing for Mummies · effects R&D · 10 Nov 2026

Which shot, which effect

Every effect in our library, re-rendered on the clip it suits best from the Content Hub and Drive, and scored. Use the shoot list to plan tomorrow: pick the effects, then shoot the matching setup.

70 effects39 different clips2 effects per clip, max8 at 9.5 (red)61 at 9/101 at 8.5

What we learned

  1. No faces in the background. The effects lock onto the biggest face they find. On the Clear Tax shot a painted face on the wall took over and pushed the comment sheet off screen. Posters, paintings and TVs showing people all count.
  2. Shoot 2 seconds of the empty frame. Dolly-zoom, head-stack and blow-away show what is behind her. Without a real empty plate that area is guessed, and it smears (36 to 60% of it on our phone takes). Only the Canon tripod shoot had one.
  3. Keep the first second still. Three takes started with a handheld jump or a pan from the table. Every effect starts at 0.4 s, so a wobble there ruins it. Start talking, then hold the camera still.
  4. Headroom decides what fits above the head. Comment sheets, toggles, search bars and headlines need a quarter of the frame free above her hair. A tight chest-up shot pushes them onto her head.
  5. Thin lines need a plain wall. Pencil words, the text ring and backdrop words disappear into the jungle wallpaper. On the plain white wall they read at full contrast.
  6. Logos orbit, pictures carousel. Orbit tiles are small and moving: use bold single logos. Carousel cards are big and slow down: use reel covers and posts with text. Carousel spin at turns 0.55.
  7. Off-centre helps the tunnel, but not enough. Rabbit hole improved on the off-centre boardroom shot and still crosses her face twice. It needs her on a third line of the frame. It is the one effect still at 8.5.
  8. Phone takes are HDR. iPhone footage is 4K HLG. Convert it with avconvert first or skin goes grey and flat. 4K also keeps punch-ins and slow pushes sharp.

Shoot list

Eleven setups cover all 70 effects. Each card says how to frame it and which effects it unlocks. Numbers match the reel labels (NN/69); tap one to jump to it. Tap any card's picture to play the effect. Every effect card has its /command for Claude and a JSON version to use anywhere else.
